gameData.backstory: Born during the Great Drip Drought of '77, Chillgoggles saw firsthand the brutal struggle for resources in Subchain City. He witnessed his flock leader, a revered elder, succumb to the freezing clutches of a Cryo-Raider gang. Swearing vengeance, Chillgoggles honed his skills in the icy outskirts, becoming a master of guerilla warfare and unconventional tactics.
gameData.name: Chillgoggles
gameData.personality: Stoic and calculating, Chillgoggles rarely emotes, his face hidden behind his signature Shock-Goggles-Cryo. He's fiercely loyal to those he deems worthy, but ruthless to his enemies, often using the environment to his advantage. Despite the grim reality, he possesses a dark sense of humor, often delivering sarcastic quips even in the heat of battle.

specialAbility.description: "Icy Retribution" - Upon taking critical damage, Chillgoggles unleashes a localized cryo-blast, freezing nearby enemies in place for 2 turns. Has a 3-turn cooldown. The blast radius is determined by his Intelligence stat, and the duration of the freeze is affected by enemy's Agility.
specialAbility.name: Icy Retribution
